faq.a: Our restaurant and entertainment areas accept credit, debit, and Spare Time cards only. Cash can be loaded onto a Spare Time card at the red teller machines near the front entrance.
Owned or Rented Bowling Shoes are required while Bowling. Shoe rental is $5.59 per person.

faq.q: Is there a minimum for birthday parties?
faq.a: Minimum of 8 children. $100 deposit required to reserve. To book weekday parties, or parties with more than 20 guests, please contact our event planners at (704) 900-2562.

faq.q: Are birthday packages for adults too?
faq.a: These packages are intended for children celebrating birthdays, and portion sizes and decorative place settings reflect that. For other types of celebrations, we recommend contacting our event experts.

faq.q: How far ahead can I reserve a lane?
faq.a: Online reservations are accepted 12 hours – 90 days in advance. Payment is required to reserve. Maximum of 12 guests/2 lanes bookable online. For larger groups, please contact our event team.

faq.q: Can I just walk in to bowl?
faq.a: Open bowling is also typically available at our everyday rates, on a first come, first serve basis. During busy times, guests can join the waitlist. We recommend calling ahead to check open bowling availability.

faq.q: What ages are escape rooms for?
faq.a: Escape room experiences are recommended for ages 13+, though younger participants may be allowed to play with adult supervision.

Thanksgiving Day (Nov 26) 3PM-11PM; Christmas Eve (Dec 24) 11AM-6PM; Christmas Day (Dec 25) 3PM-12AM; New Year's Eve (Dec 31) 10AM-1AM; New Year's Day (Jan 1) 10AM-12AM. Holiday specials are first come, first serve – no reservations.

faq.q: Can I bring a date at night?
faq.a: Bring a date for Spare Time After Dark on Friday and Saturday nights.
